subject: Re: VM evidence pack and remediation assurance for SIG
messages:
From: security@acme-payments.com
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Request: VM evidence for SIG submission

Hi Stephanie,

We're preparing our SIG submission and need Redwood's vulnerability management evidence: recent authenticated/internal scan cadence, external scan frequency, SLA commitments for Critical/High CVEs (target and historical closure times), and an attestation that Redwood follows the stated remediation windows. Could you also provide a consolidated bundle of artifacts (scan summaries, remediation log, and an attestation PDF) we can upload to the SIG portal?

Deadline: Nov 12 (SIG upload).

Attached is our SIG questionnaire — please flag any gaps we should call out.

Thanks,
Lisa Carroll
Security Program Manager
Acme Payments
Attachment: SIG-questionnaire-acme.pdf
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Carroll <lisa.carroll@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: VM evidence for SIG submission

Lisa — thanks for the heads up and the questionnaire. We can compile a VM evidence packet that covers scan cadence, SLA/SLT commitments, and a signed attestation. Proposed deliverables and timeline:

- Evidence bundle (PDF + CSV): authenticated internal scan summaries (last 90 days), external scan summary (last full quarter) — due Nov 7
- CVE closure log (CSV) with dates, severity and remediation status — due Nov 7
- Signed attestation PDF covering our SLAs for Critical/High/Medium and process notes — due Nov 7

Questions: Do you need historical percentiles for remediation (p50/p95) or just the target SLAs and a sample of recent closures? Also, do you want us to redact any internal hostnames?

I'll coordinate with Markus for the scan artifacts and Marissa for the final packaging.

-Stephanie
Stefanie "Stephanie" Nguyen
Senior Solutions Engineer (Security)
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: VM evidence for SIG submission

Looping in Evelyn (CS) for customer expectations and any redaction rules. Markus — can you confirm what scans we can export by EOD Thursday? Priority for Acme: authenticated VM (weekly agent + weekly credentialed scans) and quarterly external pen/scans. I can handle packaging and the attestation once you give the CSV and PDFs.

Evelyn Hart is on the thread to confirm redaction policy and whether the customer prefers a zip bundle or a shared Drive link.

Marissa

Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Nov 2027 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: VM artifacts ready for packaging

Hi team — I pulled the requested artifacts and verified the exports. Summary below; I've uploaded originals to the evidence folder and included a recommended redaction strip.

Scan cadence and sources:
- Authenticated internal scans: weekly (credentialed scanner w/ agent); last 12 weeks exported (CSV + PDF summaries)
- External scans: quarterly external network scan + annual 3rd-party penetration test (summary PDF attached)

SLA / remediation windows we operate to (and our observed medians over prior 12 months):
- Critical: Target SLA = 7 days; observed median = 3 days; p95 = 9 days
- High: Target SLA = 30 days; observed median = 12 days; p95 = 40 days
- Medium: Target SLA = 90 days; observed median = 45 days; p95 = 120 days

CVE remediation process notes:
- New critical CVEs are triaged immediately by on-call infra engineer; emergency patch windows can be invoked within 24 hours.
- High/Medium tracked in our ticketing system; owners assigned within 48 hours and tracked to closure.

Artifacts uploaded:
- auth-scan-report-20271101.pdf (internal summaries)
- external-scan-summary-20270930.pdf
- cve-closure-log-2027Q3.csv (fields: cve, affected_component, severity, detected_at, assigned_to, remediation_date, notes)
- internal-redaction-strip.txt

Shared evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AqRm-VM-EVIDENCE-ACME

I also created a VM evidence bundle zip (vm-evidence-bundle-20271107.zip) with the redaction applied and a brief readme. Please review the readme before sending externally.

-Markus
Engineering Operations (VM Lead)
Redwood Inference
Attachment: auth-scan-report-20271101.pdf; cve-closure-log-2027Q3.csv; external-scan-summary-20270930.pdf
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Carroll <lisa.carroll@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 7 Nov 2027 14:56:00 -0800
Subject: VM evidence packet and signed remediation attestation (Acme SIG)

Lisa — thanks for your patience. Attached is the VM evidence packet for SIG ingestion and our signed remediation attestation. Deliverables included: 

1) vm-evidence-bundle-20271107.zip (contains redacted internal scan exports, external scan summary, and CVE closure CSV)
2) auth-scan-report-20271101.pdf (sample authenticated scan summary)
3) cve-closure-log-2027Q3.csv (full closure log for Q3 with remediation dates)
4) signed-vm-attestation-20271107.pdf (formal attestation signed by Redwood Security Lead)

Key SLA summary (also in attestation):
- Critical: target 7 days (observed median 3 days; p95 9 days)
- High: target 30 days (observed median 12 days; p95 40 days)
- Medium: target 90 days (observed median 45 days; p95 120 days)

Notes and open items:
- We provided p50/p95 statistics; if the SIG requires a different framing (e.g., 30/60/90 buckets), we can regenerate the CSV.
- If you prefer a DocuSign flow for the attestation versus an attached signed PDF, we can send a DocuSign link — let us know.

Please confirm receipt and whether the bundle meets the SIG portal requirements. Happy to jump on a quick call if you want a walk-through of the evidence.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions Engineer (Security)
Redwood Inference
Attachment: vm-evidence-bundle-20271107.zip; auth-scan-report-20271101.pdf; cve-closure-log-2027Q3.csv; signed-vm-attestation-20271107.pdf
